title: New in Symfony 8.2: Signed Transports and Secret Rotation
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony 7.4 introduced signed messages in the Messenger component, so a forged
message injected into your queues can't trigger sensitive handlers, like the ones
that run commands or processes. Symfony 8.2 moves signing from handlers to
transports and lets…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
